# authwise_theme_variant (Resource)

A theme variant: a theme, changed for one issuer. It names its base theme (`theme_id`) and holds only what differs, key by key, in `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`. What applies, in order: the application's variant (`theme_variant_id`), then the audience's, then the issuer's default variant (`is_default`), then the tenant's default theme.

Formerly `authwise_appearance_profile` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_appearance_profile` carries the state across.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The issuer's default variant. A variant's stylesheet_attributes and
# content override its theme's, key by key.
resource "authwise_theme_variant" "default" {
  display_name = "Example"
  theme_id     = authwise_theme.brand.theme_id
  is_default   = true

  content = jsonencode({
    subheading = "Sign in to Example"
  })
}

# A second variant on the same theme, for one application.
resource "authwise_theme_variant" "partners" {
  display_name = "Example for partners"
  theme_id     = authwise_theme.brand.theme_id

  stylesheet_attributes = jsonencode({
    primary_main = "5B4B8A"
    link_color   = "5B4B8A"
  })

  content = jsonencode({
    heading    = "Partner portal"
    subheading = "Sign in with your partner account"
  })
}

resource "authwise_application" "portal" {
  display_name     = "Partner portal"
  audience_id      = authwise_audience.portal.audience_id
  grant_types      = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
  config           = data.authwise_interactive_client_config.portal.any
  theme_variant_id = authwise_theme_variant.partners.theme_variant_id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String)
- `theme_id` (String)

### Optional

- `content` (String) `content` as a JSON object.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this variant is its issuer's default, and so what the issuer's pages use where no application or audience names a variant. Set it to `true` on the one variant that should be the default, and leave it out on the others. The issuer's first variant becomes the default whatever this says. To move the default, set it on the new variant and remove it from the old one.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String) `stylesheet_attributes` as a JSON object.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `theme_variant_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_theme_variant.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/theme-variants/ap-01
```
